segments.name: Communications
segments.description: Builds and maintains communications infrastructure in data centers.
segments.evidence: Our operations are organized into four business segments, based upon the nature of our services: • Communications – Nationwide provider of technology infrastructure services, including the design, build, and maintenance of the communications infrastructure within data centers for co-location and managed hosting customers, for both large corporations and independent businesses.
